title: Astrid and the Postcard
author: Lior Sandoval
blurb: Hazel Hartwell, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
